content:
tvOS 27 will be released next month as the next system version for Apple TV users. Based on two reasons, this update may push you to upgrade to a brand-new Apple TV 4K.

Siri AI and tvOS 27 phasing out older models make it a great time to upgrade Apple TV 4K

When it comes to new system releases, Apple TV often fails to receive the same attention as Apple's other products. This is understandable, because for Apple, the Apple TV business is much smaller in scale than iPhone, Mac, iPad, and even Apple Watch.

However, even though the most important changes have not yet been announced, tvOS 27 is expected to bring some notable upgrades.

According to rumors, Apple will add various AI features in tvOS 27, with the most highly anticipated being the all-new Siri AI.

When Siri AI was unveiled at WWDC, every Apple platform except two had announced support — these two platforms being Apple TV and HomePod. Reports indicate this is because Apple is about to launch brand-new Apple TV 4K and HomePod hardware, and only these new devices will unlock the completely revamped Siri.

Based on the goals Apple has set for Siri AI, the voice assistant in tvOS will be able to perform all the same functions as on other platforms. This will be a major upgrade for the currently feature-limited Siri.

The Siri and other AI upgrades in tvOS 27 make me really want to buy the upcoming all-new Apple TV 4K.

But there is another reason why tvOS 27 may trigger a new wave of Apple TV purchases: it will no longer support older models.

The new system will not support Apple TV HD and the first-generation Apple TV 4K. These are both quite popular models, and many households may still be using them in their living rooms.

Combining the AI features exclusive to the all-new Apple TV 4K with tvOS 27 dropping support for popular models, now is the best time to upgrade your hardware.
